en-US.author: halgari
en-US.description: An automated Modlist installer for various games
en-US.longDescription:
Wabbajack is an automated Modlist Installer that can reproduce an entire modding setup on another machine without bundling any assets or re-distributing any mods.
It supports various games and mod managers, making it easy to share and install complete modding setups.
en-US.name: Wabbajack
en-US.releaseNotes:
#### Version - 4.3.2.2 - 11/05/2026
• Metrics improvements
• Added Vampire：The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 support ([@daulvec](https://github.com/daulvec)) PR #3032
• Added American McGee's Alice and Alice：Madness Returns support ([@daulvec](https://github.com/daulvec)) PR #3100
